headline: Brown Says A Word, Scott Says Nothing
deck: Scott, owned by test3331, gets a mention in a Celtic-Rangers preview that carries no draft weight.
body:
Scott Brown holds forth on Sunday's derby, and somewhere in the copy sits the name test3331 will care about. Scott is on those rolls, and a big Old Firm afternoon is the sort that reads across to a fantasy owner watching from a distance.

What the wire gives is a preview and a former captain's verdict, no more. No line-up, no minutes, no fitness note attached to Scott. test3331 knows the fixture is coming and knows nothing beyond it, and neither do we.
